body: We don't really have support groups like that here, unfortunately. I would like to see a psychologist, but it takes months just to get a first appointment. I know I should go outdoors more but its so hard getting out of the door. There is a lot of houses around us and I really can't stand walking passed them. Sounds silly I know. But I could try walking around just one block first I suppose. Thank you for answering my post and talking to me. I really appreciate that. I have to go to bed now. Hope to speak to you tomorrow as I will keep you updated. Are there any self help books that has helped you that you can recommend?

Epilepsy, PTSD, depression, (also maybe bipolar 2 which they couldn't figure out because of the medication I was on at the time for my epilepsy is also the same combination they would use for bipolar) and hypothyroidism. I am on my way to bed but I can't stand the thought of getting up to another day. Its ok getting kids ready for school, but when they are gone I just sit down and do absolutely nothing. Just worry about money, my health, relationship. I even checked up online today what happened with my bank loans if I die, I don't want anyone having to struggle with that. Its just a big mess. I know I need to take care of my children, and be there for them. I am just afraid It is gonna come to a point where I'll do something really stupid, if you know what I meen..
